documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our managed services team requested discovery about inconsistent reporting. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer has expressed a need related to 'inconsistent reporting' and has requested a discovery meeting to address it. However, there is contradictory information in the latest call: the project is paused, and the owner disagrees about the requirement. This creates operational friction for the customer, as they are unsure whether to proceed with the discovery meeting or not.

claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our managed services team requested discovery about inconsistent reporting.
The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your team has requested a discovery meeting to address inconsistent reporting, but there appears to be some confusion regarding the current project status. Could you clarify whether the project is still active and whether the discovery meeting remains a priority? This will help us ensure we align with your needs and expectations.
questions: Can you confirm if the project is still active and whether the discovery meeting is still required?
Are there any specific concerns the owner has about the requirement that we should be aware of?
uncertainties: The project status is unclear (paused or active).
The owner's disagreement with the requirement is not fully explained.
